evidence.FACTS: Removed generic claims (« retour d’expérience des conducteurs », « sérénité en cas de pépin », douceur de commande, discrétion, « grilles dégressives ») and the stacked contract list (caution, franchise, assistance). Added only sourced specs: Latte 125 cm3, selle 790 mm, réservoir 5,0 L, coffre jusqu’à 37 L fond plat, poids en ordre de marche 100 kg, conso annoncée 1,8 L/100 km (Yamaha Motor Vietnam, seen in search result); Vision selle 761 mm (785 mm sur une page de comparaison), réservoir 4,8 L, coffre/vide-poche avant avec couvercle et port USB-C sans volume chiffré (honda.com.vn, seen in search result). Prices: Vision own row 200 000 / 1 000 000 / 2 000 000 VND; Latte has no owner row, only the automatic-scooter category range 150 000–200 000 / 600 000–1 000 000 / 1 200 000–2 000 000 « à titre de repère », with the mandatory disclaimer; no multiplication, no claim that Latte is cheaper or dearer. Policies: assistance/dépannage phrased as a question to ask the loueur (numéro, atelier), not as a shop policy; passenger acceptance phrased as a question. Permit: Law 36/2024/QH15, A1 up to 125 cm3 / A above, cited to xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn (consulté 2026-10-29, seen in search result), with the caveat that validity of a foreign licence depends on the issuing country; link to /permis-securite/permis/. Vision availability/stock not claimed.

evidence.FACTS: The Latte has no owner row. The article states this once and uses only the category range « scooter automatique » (150 000–200 000 / 600 000–1 000 000 / 1 200 000–2 000 000 VND) « à titre de repère », with the mandatory disclaimer next to the price table and in the FAQ; table also shows semi-automatic, electric (day « selon le modèle, à confirmer ») and the Honda Vision own row (200 000 / 1 000 000 / 2 000 000). No multiplication of day rates, no euro conversion (FAQ says none is offered), no claim that the Latte is cheaper/dearer. Removed the old text asserting a dégressif semaine (« la décote entre en scène »), the claims about « dépôt de garantie, assurance et franchise » as bill lines, and the closing remarks on rayon d’action. Deposit, casques, carburant, hours counting, assistance, payment mode and currency are written only as questions to ask the loueur (one dedicated checklist), each stated as unconfirmed. Market observations are phrased « certains loueurs ajustent… (Têt) ». Specs only qualitative or manufacturer-sourced: 125 cm3, coffre jusqu’à 37 L, réservoir 5,0 L, conso annoncée 1,8 L/100 km (Yamaha Motor Vietnam, seen in search result); the « plus de 250 km en théorie » is derived from those two figures and flagged as theoretical. NAP/hours as in SEO-FACTS (0334 699 969, Zalo/WhatsApp, 09:00–21:00, Ngõ 5 Nguyễn Văn Cừ, près du Bến xe Gia Lâm).
